keys.statement: Include reboilers and condensers in the pinch analysis, and place each column so it sits entirely above or entirely below the pinch.

source.locator: Pinch analysis of the full system, p. 15

decisions.obstacle: Columns left out of heat integration.
decisions.mechanism: A column across the pinch moves heat across it.
decisions.operation: Analyse the full system; place columns on one side.

keys.statement: Never transfer heat across the pinch, which costs twice in utilities; at the pinch, match streams so the hot stream's heat-capacity flow is no larger than the cold one's above the pinch and no smaller below it.

decisions.mechanism: Cross-pinch transfer raises both hot and cold utility.

keys.statement: Place heat engines such as steam turbines to reject heat below the pinch; in this plant that reduced external cooling by about another 6%.

decisions.mechanism: Rejecting heat below the pinch uses heat that would otherwise go to cooling.
decisions.operation: Position the engine using the grand composite curve.
